references.text: Abram asks Sarai to say she is his sister because she is beautiful and he fears being killed – a direct parallel to Isaac's actions with Rebekah.
Abraham tells Abimelech in Gerar that Sarah is his sister, an action that Isaac repeats with Rebekah in the same place.
Abimelech discovers that Rebekah is Isaac's wife and confronts him about the lie.
Fear of people sets a trap, but whoever trusts in the Lord will be safe – thematically relevant to Isaac's fear-motivated lie.
Isaac's fear in 26:7 is a direct repetition of Abraham's fear and strategy in 12:12.
The consequence of the lying in 26:7 mirrors the conclusion of Abraham's corresponding action in 12:19.
